items.headline: Netherlands hire Xavi as coach through 2030 WC
items.detail: The Netherlands have appointed Barcelona great Xavi Hernández as the national team's new coach following the resignation of Ronald Koeman after a disappointing FIFA World Cup.
items.relevance_reason: ESPN precision source; matches world cup

items.headline: Will World Cup's top player Rodri join Barcelona or Real Madrid? Or stay at Man City?
items.detail: After Rodri led Spain to World Cup glory, it's no surprise that Barcelona and Real Madrid both want him. Will he move this summer or remain at Man City?
items.relevance_reason: ESPN precision source; matches world cup

items.headline: Freeman 'in good spirits' after fall into dugout
items.detail: Dodgers first baseman Freddie Freeman apparently avoided serious injury when he took a frightening tumble down the stairs and into the visitors dugout while trying to catch a foul popup.

items.headline: Skenes lifted after 65 pitches, mum on velo drop
items.detail: Paul Skenes, battling another dip in his fastball velocity, was lifted after just 65 pitches in Tuesday's loss to the Marlins, leading to further speculation about the health status of the reigning NL Cy Young Award winner.

items.headline: Daniels miffed over LSU giving Pickett his No. 5
items.detail: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels informed LSU it can no longer use his name, image and likeness and said he felt "profoundly disrespected" after LSU allowed cornerback DJ Pickett to wear his former No. 5 jersey.

items.headline: WNBA task force discusses transgender athletes
items.detail: A task force of team presidents and general managers met Wednesday and discussed transgender athletes but did not arrive at any eligibility rules.

items.headline: Inside the disunited United States that shadows the WNBA
items.detail: Sophie Cunningham said what she said about transgender women in sports. Now others want their say, whether the WNBA wants to hear them or not.

items.headline: Portland Fire sign Nigeria's Okonkwo as injury sub
items.detail: The Portland Fire have signed Nigeria captain Amy Okonkwo to a standard WNBA contract, giving the two-time Women's AfroBasket MVP another opportunity in the league after productive spells with the Dallas Wings and Atlanta Dream.

items.headline: 📈 How Caitlin Clark's game has grown in Year 3
items.detail: Clark already has the most 20-point, 10-assist games in WNBA history. But her game remains a work in progress.

items.headline: Sources: Simeone, Álvarez hold talks at Atlético
items.detail: Diego Simeone and Julían Alvarez met ahead of Atlético Madrid's training session on Wednesday to discuss the star forward's situation, sources have told ESPN, in their first meeting since Álvarez revealed that he wants to leave the club this summer.

items.headline: PSG edge Villa to win back-to-back Super Cups
items.detail: Paris Saint-Germain won the UEFA Super Cup for a second straight year by beating Aston Villa 2-1 on Wednesday thanks to Désiré Doué's second-half goal in the annual curtain-raiser to the European soccer season.

items.headline: Sources: Gala make bid for Arsenal's Martinelli
items.detail: Galatasaray have made a €45million ($51.8m) bid to sign Gabriel Martinelli from Arsenal, sources have told ESPN.

items.headline: Arteta welcomes speculation around Lewis-Skelly
items.detail: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has brushed off transfer speculation surrounding Myles Lewis-Skelly, saying he welcomes his players being linked with moves to other clubs.

items.headline: Mazraoui: Pitch invaders show 'big love' for United
items.detail: Noussair Mazraoui kept his cool amid a bizarre finish to Manchester United's pre-season friendly in Dublin, rolling in the decisive penalty as they beat Leeds United 5-4 in a shoot-out.

items.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea eye Arsenal's Zubimendi to replace Man City target Enzo Fernández
items.detail: Chelsea could sign Arsenal midfielder Martín Zubimendi if Enzo Fernández joins Manchester City this summer. Transfer Talk has the latest.
